summary: Resources Connection, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the entry into a $30 million secured revolving credit facility with PNC Bank and other lenders, maturing July 15, 2031. The facility includes a $15 million swingline sublimit and a $5 million letter of credit sublimit, with an uncommitted $20 million accordion feature. Borrowings bear interest at Term SOFR plus 1.75%-2.25% or ABR plus 0.75%-1.25%. This is a routine financing arrangement for working capital and general corporate purposes, not a special situation.
